set.statement: rhiza run resume continues an unfinished plan-workflow run whose change set has landed (a plan run lands its record during the interview), while it still refuses a plan run whose change set is rejected, withdrawn or superseded, and any other workflow's run whose change set is no longer in flight, except a non-plan run on a landed change set that reached its land step (run-resume-landed-past-land); a non-plan run on a landed change set that never reached land is refused
